Either way, happy to rebook — tell me which slot works or I’ll send the checklist and a one-time demo key that expires in 48 hours.

We definitely want to continue; the 2:00–2:20pm PT slot tomorrow would be ideal for a short live handoff. If that gets tight on your end I’m also fine with asynchronous instructions for the key plus a short pre-baked sample request (we can validate internally before a live call).

2) We sit behind a proxy/VPN and sometimes need IP allowlisting – I’ve added our network admin Tom (tom.rivers@orbithealth.com) to this thread in case you need exact IP ranges.

Thanks — Emily
